beats.label: Do Now — the map, cold
beats.line: This class lost Monday to a fire drill and a pep rally, so they are seeing the map for the first time at 2:05.

board.head: DO NOW
lines: You are allowed to be wrong.

beats.label: Context — eleven and eleven
beats.line: Same two numbers you have said twice already today. Say them like it is the first time, because for them it is.

beats.label: Model — read the terms
beats.line: Read the first clause yourself. Do the second one with them. They will not do the third at this hour unless you wait for it.

beats.label: The argument — who does the line protect?
beats.line: Nobody in here has heard 'kicked the can' yet. Ask the question and hold the silence longer than is comfortable.
beats.note: student-led discourse — a rubric look-for, if anyone were watching

beats.label: Exit ticket
beats.line: Half sheet, one sentence, and the last four minutes of the school day between them and the parking lot.

board.head: EXIT TICKET
lines: What did the line at 36°30′ do?
Name on it. Yes, first AND last.

filler.label: Sustained silent work
filler.line: Sixth period can read a clock. Two of them have been reading it since you started talking.

seatingCopy.sub: RM 214 · 6TH PERIOD · 4 MINUTES BEFORE THE BELL
intro: Fifth period left four minutes ago and took most of your voice with them. The desks are wherever that class left them, and this one has never sat in any of it.
Drag a name onto another name to swap them. The room is drawn from above; the whiteboard is at the top, same as it ever is.
The cabinet and the bookshelf still drag. Whatever blind spot you built this morning, you are still teaching behind it.
